# Context menu journey throws inside DOM event delegation

## Context

The current NL battery lists `ContextMenuNL` as an unowned real Engine error in #17844. Independently reproduced on `dev@a186e92cfa34dcea086f991aaa037de5a4a289e3` on 2026-09-23: the existing full `test/playwright/e2e/rendering/ContextMenuNL.spec.mjs` reaches its final state assertions, then fails on two `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'includes')` errors from `DomEvent.verifyDelegationPath` at line 649. One test failed in 2.0s; worker/page-error guards were unchanged.

## The Problem

A normal context-menu journey completes placement, nested action and dismissal while event delivery throws. The error is not an expected rejected tool request: the worker's delegation reader accesses `path[j].cls.includes(...)` on a node without `cls`. Swallowing or exempting that error would leave event dispatch incomplete.

## The Architectural Reality

`src/main/DomEvents.mjs#getTargetData` normally supplies `cls: []` even for classless nodes. `src/manager/DomEvent.mjs#fire` routes event paths through `verifyDelegationPath`, which owns selector matching and physical/logical ancestor boundaries. Existing unit coverage is `test/playwright/unit/manager/domEvent/Delegation.spec.mjs`; the real-browser witness is the existing ContextMenu NL spec. `src/main/addon/Navigator.mjs#setActiveItem` deliberately emits `neonavigate` with `path: [{id: data.id}]`. The default delegate is the owning component's `#id`; when menu ownership bubbles the event to an ancestor, the ID mismatch incorrectly falls through to `.cls.includes`. No producer lost data: the selector reader mixes the ID and class branches. Two focused controls reproduce the missing-class exception and a same-named class incorrectly satisfying an ID selector.

## The Fix

Use mutually exclusive ID/class comparison in `DomEvent.verifyDelegationPath`, and extend its existing focused coverage. Preserve selector matching and physical/logical ancestry semantics. No new file or abstraction is prescribed.

## Contract Ledger

| Surface | Authority | Required behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| DOM event path / `verifyDelegationPath` | Existing main-thread event projection and worker delegation contract | ID selectors read IDs only; valid ID-only navigation paths complete dispatch without throwing | Unmatched delegation remains false | Document the corrected producer/reader contract at its owner | Focused regression and existing ancestry controls |
| Context-menu interaction | Existing `ContextMenuNL` journey | Reused menu, nested action and dismissal remain correct with no worker/page errors | None | Existing spec | Whole-file browser run |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The failing event/path shape and the first responsible producer or mutation are identified with a receipt.
- [ ] A focused regression fails against the original mechanism and passes with the repair.
- [ ] The existing ContextMenuNL whole file passes without weakening error guards or semantic assertions.
- [ ] Existing physical, logical portal/menu and non-descendant delegation controls remain green.

## Out of Scope

Menu focus/navigation redesign, broad selector parsing, masking unexpected worker errors, the remaining NL battery failures.

## Avoided Traps

Do not infer that every missing `cls` is an acceptable wire shape merely from the throwing consumer; the normal producer supplies it. Do not credit a green final menu state as complete event execution when the error channel is red.
